fullPassage: It was lunchtime, and a group of us were picnicking with our kids. Three-year-old Jack was having a tantrum in front of his father. His dad picked him up, held his arms pressed against his body so he couldn't wiggle around, put his face close to the toddler's, and said, "Now tell me what you want. Don't whine or hit, just tell me, and then I can help you." Jack was pouty for another moment; then he said, "I'm very hungry, Daddy, and I don't want any of those things for lunch." Having witnessed this episode, Marsha later asked Jack's dad if he knew what the youngster had wanted. "Of course," he said. "But I wanted him to tell me. I say all the time to him, 'Use your words.' So does my wife, but she means, 'Don't whine.' I mean, 'Explain what you want.'"

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ was picnicking → were picnicking: 'a group of us were picnicking'에서 주어 'a group of us'는 복수 의미(우리 중 한 무리)로 복수 동사 were가 맞음. 'a group of us'는 화자를 포함한 복수 집단을 지칭할 때 복수 취급.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ was picnicking: a group of us는 복수 의미로 were picnicking이 맞음. was는 단수형으로 오류
✅ ① having: Jack was having a tantrum → 과거진행형 was + -ing 정상
✅ ② pressed: held his arms pressed against his body → 과거분사 pressed가 his arms의 상태를 수식(분사보어) 정상
✅ ④ said: put his face close to the toddler's, and said → 과거시제 등위연결 정상
det.tip: a group of us were picnicking: us(우리들)를 포함한 집단 → 복수 동사 were. 'a group of + 복수명사'는 복수 취급.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: whine or hit: 빈칸은 'Don't __________, just tell me'. 떼쓰기(whine) 또는 때리기(hit)를 하지 말고 말로 표현하라는 훈육 메시지. 이어지는 'just tell me'와 자연스럽게 연결.

❌ ② pick me up: 아버지의 행동 묘사용 표현. 아이에게 금지할 행동 아님
❌ ④ use your words: 아버지가 권장하는 행동. 'Don't' 뒤에 오면 의미 역전
det.tip: Don't __________, just tell me → 떼쓰거나 때리지 말고 말해 → whine or hit.
